 Imran Khan's Plea Against 'Leave India' Notice : Live Updates From Bombay High Court
 LIVELAW NEWS NETWORK 
 26 Oct 2026 2:58 PM IST
 Share this 
 Listen to this Article Bombay High Court to hear today at 3 PM petition filed by Actor Imran Khan who has challenged a "Leave India Notice" issued to him by the FRRO, Mumbai, for participating in the anti-CEC protests. 
 Bench led by Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi is told that Solicitor General Tushar Mehta will appear in this matter. 
 Live Updates
 2026-10-26 09:28:03 26 Oct 2026 3:07 PM IST Bench has assembled. 
 SG appears for Union Govt. 
 Sr Adv Venkatesh Dhond for Imran Khan seeks short adjournment. 
 Matter kept tomorrow at 3 PM
